title: Teodoro: Chinese envoy’s remarks a threat, not a ‘slip’

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. on Friday backed the Department of Foreign Affairs’ (DFA) assessment of Chinese Ambassador Jing Quan’s remarks, saying his statement about the use of force was a threat meant to intimidate the Philippines. Teodoro said defense officials were studying the statements, rejecting the possibility that the ambassador had merely misspoken. “Pinag-aaralan talaga namin ang statement na ito kasi hindi dulas ’yun eh,” Teodoro said in a DZMM Teleradyo interview. (We are really studying this statement because that was not a slip of the tongue.) READ: China can ‘easily win’ using force, but wants peace, […]...
